_source: Pass 2 of the Cleaning Services port: contact lifecycle type, email engagement tags, and a 12-month event-ideas nurture in place of their 52-week cold drip. Review gate lives in workflow_build_pass4.json once the survey exists.

steps.name: 2 - Email: Thanks again + what people book next

attributes.subject: Thanks again, {{contact.first_name}} - and what people book next
attributes.preview: A month on from your event
attributes.html:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

It's been about a month since we set up the {{custom_values.rental_asset_name}} for your {{contact.event_type}}. Thanks again for having us.

A quick note on what past hosts tend to do next: the same crowd, a different reason. Birthdays, work socials, a holiday party, a fundraiser. If any of those are on the calendar, you already know what the setup looks like at your place.

Reply to this email or text {{custom_values.business_phone}} any time. No forms needed.

{{custom_values.owner_first_name}}
{{custom_values.business_name}}

attributes.subject: The easiest team event you'll plan this year
attributes.html:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

If you or someone you know runs a team, this is the one thing we'd suggest: a {{custom_values.rental_asset_name}} at the office, the shop or the plant. Nobody has to be a golfer. Everyone gets a turn. It runs itself while people eat.

Corporate events start at {{custom_values.corporate_starting_price}} and we build them around your headcount and hours.

Want a quote for a date? Reply with the date and roughly how many people.

{{custom_values.owner_first_name}}
{{custom_values.business_name}}

attributes.subject: Holiday party dates go first
attributes.preview: Weekends in November and December fill fast
attributes.html:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Every year the same thing happens: the November and December weekends are gone by early fall. We have one unit, so once a Saturday is booked it's booked.

If a holiday party, an end-of-season get-together or a family gathering is on your list, tell us the date now and we'll check it while it's still open. No deposit needed to ask.

Reply with the date, or text {{custom_values.business_phone}}.

{{custom_values.owner_first_name}}
{{custom_values.business_name}}

attributes.subject: A closest-to-the-pin contest raises real money
attributes.preview: Fundraiser ideas that work with a simulator
attributes.html:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Schools, churches, booster clubs and charities book us for one reason: a closest-to-the-pin or long-drive contest is easy to sell tickets to, easy to sponsor, and fun to watch.

We help structure the contest, keep the line moving, and a sponsor can put their name on the screen.

If you're involved with a fundraiser this year, reply and we'll talk through how it usually works.

{{custom_values.owner_first_name}}
{{custom_values.business_name}}

attributes.subject: Same time next year, {{contact.first_name}}?
attributes.preview: Your date from last year is coming back around
attributes.html:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Your event with us was around this time last year. If it's becoming a tradition, we'd love to be part of it again.

Past hosts get first call on their date. Reply with the date you have in mind and we'll hold a spot on the calendar for a few days while you confirm.

{{custom_values.owner_first_name}}
{{custom_values.business_name}}
{{custom_values.business_phone}}
